title: The number of originations of each offense

verses.t: When it comes to the offenses for having sexual intercourse, through how many of the six kinds of originations of offenses do they originate? They originate in one way: from body and mind, not from speech. …

When it comes to the offense for, out of disrespect, defecating, urinating, or spitting in water, through how many of the six kinds of originations of offenses does it originate? It originates in one way: from body and mind, not from speech.
The number of originations of each offense, the fifth, are finished.
